title: Zainab Tera Baba Mur Nai Auna
body:
Zainab Tera Baba Mur Nai Auna
Kalme Da Waaris Tur Peya Ay, Deway Jabreel Sadaawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Ghurbat De Din Aa Gaye Ne, Zulmaan De Hanere Chaa Gaye Ne
Tere Veeraan Marna Wich Karbal, Tu Rulna Shaam Di Raawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jidi Kul Dunya Te Shaahi Si, Jiday Maan Te Kufay Aayi Si
Oh Aakhiri Sajda Kar Baitha, Na Ro Ro Bhaar Hun Haawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Chum Kafan Kaway Dardaan Maari, Mai Ronaa Zindagi Saari
Chad Kabar Teri Wich Kufay De, Mai Yasrab Kevain Jaawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoyi Qatal Namaz Hai Wich Sajde, Tu Karna Ay Kaadey Sajde
Hai Naam Ali Allah Da Ay, Aa Khol Quraan Vakhaawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Ro Farmaya Paak Ali, Mera Bachra Tu Abbas E Jarri
Meri Mayyat Nu Tu Na Chaaveen, Teri Katiyan Jaaniyan Baawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Kul Dunya Da Waali Ay, Tere Matmi Dar Te Sawaali Ne
Tu Bhar De Khali Jholiyaan Nu, Mungda Mumtaaz Duawaan
